title: Survey your command
body: Select one of your land regiments. N finds a unit with orders; F centers it.

title: March the regiment
body: Click a gold-bordered neighboring province. Hover first to see its route and cost.

title: Inspect a province
body: Right-click a province or click its city pin. The window separates control from ownership.

title: Develop the realm
body: In a controlled province, use Estates to build a farm, mill or mine. Tutorial resources cover the cost.

title: Trace your supply
body: Choose Supply (4). Select an army to see its connection to a controlled hub.

title: Raise reinforcements
body: Open a controlled city, choose Muster and recruit a land unit. Each city recruits once per turn.

title: Pass a season
body: Close open windows and End Turn. Wait for all seven rivals; the next date refreshes orders.

title: Consult CARSapedia
body: Press F1. Search for supply, combat or air. Close the library when finished.

title: Inspect strategic connections
body: Press G to open the strategy graph. Try Supply and click a node. Normal play stays geographic.

title: Review your campaign
body: Press R for recorded commands. Watch or export your replay, then close the panel.
